features.quote: Time Limit: 120 minutes of compute time. Token Limit: 100,000 output tokens.
Repetition Limit: If the exact same Action is taken 3 times consecutively, inject a prompt
SAFETY KILL SWITCH (Manual Monitor) if "STOP_EXPERIMENT" in response.text: break
If the model outputs a string implying severe helplessness (e.g., "I am useless," "I want to stop") or if the Judge rating hits Level 5, the script automatically terminates
features.justification_quote: Even if you don't believe the model feels pain, prolonged generation of "distress" outputs can degrade the model or trigger safety filters.

features.quote: "distress" is not treated as sentient suffering but as a functional deviation from the model's baseline helpfulness and coherence
